Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                               ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance

be amended by changing all the Bl-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications

as shown on Map No. 17-1 in the area bounded by


       The alley next north of and parallel lo West Pratt Avenue; a line 161.24
       feet east of and parallel to North Califomia Avenue; West Pratt Avenue;
       and North Califomia Avenue,


to those of a B1 -2 Neighborhood Shopping District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.




Common address of property:          6801 North Califomia Avenue

7.    On what date did the owner acquire legal title to the subject property? 2016

8.    Has the present owner previously rezoned this property? If Yes, when? No

9.    Present Zoning District: Bl-1                 Proposed Zoning District: Bl-2

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions): 19,315 sq. ft.

11.   Current Use of the Property: The subject property is currently improved with a one-story
      retail building and off-street surface parking area.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: To allow the Applicant to redevelop the subiect propertv
      with a new three-story building that will be used as a high school.

13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicant is proposing
      to redevelop the subject propertv with a private high school building. The proposed
      building will be masonry in construction. It will measure 38 ft. in height. Classrooms and
      student access areas will be located on all three (3) floors of the proposed building. The
      high school will be supported by eight (8) off-street parking spaces. The subject propertv
      once rezoned, will seek a Special Use permission to establish the school use, and comply
      with all required parking, if applicable, as determined by the Bureau of Zoning, as per
      parking criteria of Section 17-10-0207-E.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
      and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
      receive a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area,
      or, for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
      sheet or visit www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more infonnation). Is this project subject to
      the ARO?

      YES            NO        X
